hidden_risks: Panel condition (dead pixels, scratches, or pressure marks when off)
Presence and condition of the original remote control
Internal repair history or motherboard faults
response.best_proof: The photo showing the smart hub interface active, proving the screen and software load, though physical condition and rear model label remain unseen.
response.failure_mode: Assuming exact model specifications and release year from basic UI screenshots, leading to mispricing since Samsung UHD TVs span a wide range of generations and price points.
